chip.description: PC Engine CPU: 65C02-derived core with added instructions, integrated PSG, memory-mapping unit and timer; taxonomy TB1 files it as cpu.
chip.notes: Designed by Hudson Soft — manufacturer_id deliberately omitted until a Hudson Soft row exists in the lookup vocabulary. Filed in the m6502 family as a 65C02 derivative. coverage.md §2.1 treats 'huc6280 provides m65c02' (superset CPU core) as the defensible equivalence direction.
